description: Risk-band-scaled multipliers for the PvE AI ally: the second friendly slot in solo battles and the offline partner in interval PvE.

Id.technical: FName row key (header field Id; retail UStruct/export label ID, ImportKeyField Id). Exported values PVE_ALLY_PARAMETER_01..05 equal their row names. The observed helper enumerates all rows from PvEAllyParameterDataTables with FGameDataTableArray::GetRows and never reads this value; selection is through Id_GlobalThreshold.

Id_GlobalThreshold.simple: Risk-value band that selects this parameter row.
Id_GlobalThreshold.technical: FName, default None. GamePvE_FindThresholdInline resolves it against GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300; first table/row wins) and tests the int32 RiskValue against inclusive Min/Max. Exported ally bands, in row order: 01=0-5000, 02=5001-10000, 03=10001-15000, 04=15001-25000, 05=25001-99999. A missing threshold row or a risk outside all bands returns null and no ally multipliers are applied. These are distinct from the PVE_AI_LEVEL_* bands used for the AI level.

HitPointMaxRate.simple: Multiplier for the ally's maximum hit points.
HitPointMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f; the export supplies 1.0/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5. For the partner only, GamePvE_CalcHitPoint starts from Growth->HitPointMaxRate or 1.0, multiplies by this ally rate, applies HitPointMaxRate and HitPointMaxRateAlly vow factors (positive ally vow values use the maximum) and additive HitPointMax equipment/vow terms, then floors the result at 1.0f. Used for the solo partner's HP override and the interval partner's maximum HP; enemies use MissionCharacter.HitPoint with a HitPointMaxEnemy gear bonus instead.

CursedEnergyExpAddRate.simple: Ally multiplier for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExpAddRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f; the export uses 1.0/1.03/1.05. Only the AI partner (solo slot index 1) adds (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.CursedEnergyExp, whose neutral default is 1.0f; the growth row's contribution is added on top. The downstream exp-rate calculation folds in this setup rate with buffs, equipment and vows and clamps the result at 0.0f.

CursedEnergyRecoverRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f; all exported rows set 1.0. Only the AI partner (solo slot index 1) adds (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.CursedEnergyRecover (neutral default 1.0f) before the growth-row contribution; the downstream recovery rate includes this setup rate and is clamped at 0.0f.

GuardDurabilityMaxRate.simple: Ally multiplier for maximum guard durability.
GuardDurabilityMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f; all exported rows set 1.0. Only the AI partner (solo slot index 1) adds (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.GuardDurabilityMax (neutral default 1.0f) before the growth-row contribution. The controller folds that rate with equipment and binding vows; the character multiplies the result by the battle manager's team guard-durability rate to obtain the effective rate, which is applied to a base durability value.

DashGaugeMaxRate.simple: Ally multiplier for maximum dash gauge.
DashGaugeMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f; all exported rows set 1.0. Only the AI partner (solo slot index 1) adds (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.DashGaugeMax (neutral default 1.0f) before the growth-row contribution; the controller folds that rate with equipment and vows, and dash-gauge clamping uses Owner->GetDashGaugeMaxRate() times the dash-gauge base value.

DamageRate.simple: Ally multiplier for sent attack damage.
DamageRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f; the export uses 1.0/1.1/1.2/1.4/1.6. Only the AI partner (solo slot index 1) adds (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.SendAttackDamage (neutral default 1.0f) before the growth-row contribution. The character's damage-rate product includes the team, action and status rates; the status rate folds in this setup rate together with equipment and binding-vow terms.

notes: The sole exported asset has 5 rows (PVE_ALLY_PARAMETER_01..05) with FGameDataTableRow_PvEAllyParameter; the manager registers PvEAllyParameterDataTable at GameDataTableManager.cpp:453 and resolves it into PvEAllyParameterDataTables (DTM+0x960) at :280 once all primary-asset loaders complete. No localization variants or numbered shards exist in the supplied exports.

Id_GlobalThreshold joins to GlobalThresholdDataTable: inclusive integer bands 0-5000, 5001-10000, 10001-15000, 15001-25000 and 25001-99999 in exported row order. A negative risk or one above 99999 has no ally row. These bands do not align with PVE_AI_LEVEL_* (for example AI level 3 covers 0-600) even though both lookups consume the same risk value.

In solo battle setup the ally is entry index 1 (ControlType 3/AI). All six numeric fields are consumed: five are added as (rate - 1) to the neutral-1.0 StatusSetup.Rates fields, and HitPointMaxRate is used through GamePvE_CalcHitPoint. Index 0 (local player) receives no ally-parameter rates. The growth row's matching rate is added on top for index 1; no clamp is applied at the setup step.

Interval PvE resolves this table only when bAlly is true (offline partner; BuildPartnerInfo sets Value4C=1 when not online) and uses only HitPointMaxRate via the HP helper. It indexes RiskValueArray[CharacterIndex] directly after guarding GrowthInfoArray and EquipmentItemIds, so it relies on the caller having supplied one risk per character.

Exported multipliers are explicit (HP 1.0-1.5, DamageRate 1.0-1.6, CursedEnergyExpAddRate up to 1.05, the other three rates 1.0). The reconstructed row ctor defaults all float members to 0.0f (not neutral 1.0f) and FName members to None, so a missing or zero serialized multiplier would not be neutral.

Tag battle setup applies growth rows but performs no ally-parameter lookup. The row-selection helper 0x1303d20 and null-ally HP forwarder 0x1305490 are byte-matched; the seven-argument HP helper 0x13054c0 and the Solo/Interval callers are behaviour-certified rather than byte-matched (status/functions.json). Retail Blueprint assets are unavailable for exhaustive inspection, but no alternate C++ consumer of this struct/table name exists in Source/.
Retail layout evidence lists the eight properties at offsets 0x08..0x2C (ID/NameProperty x2 then six FloatProperty), matching the reconstructed header's field order and types.

usages.detail: GamePvE_GetAllyParameter enumerates ally rows in table/row-name order and returns the first whose GlobalThreshold band includes the risk value.
Resolves PvEAllyParameterDataTable through the primary-asset loader into PvEAllyParameterDataTables (DTM+0x960).
Resolves the partner row from RiskValueArray[1] for the AI-controlled entry at slot index 1.
Applies five ally rate fields as (rate - 1) adjustments to the partner's neutral StatusSetup.Rates; growth-row adjustments are added afterward.
Passes HitPointMaxRate through GamePvE_CalcHitPoint for the partner's maximum-HP override.
GamePvE_CalcHitPoint multiplies the growth HP rate by the ally HP rate before equipment/vow terms and the 1.0 floor.
Resolves the ally row for the offline partner only, using that character's risk value.
Passes the ally row to GamePvE_CalcHitPoint for the interval partner's maximum HP; no other ally fields are read there.
